# highlight.js 11.12.0

Vendored from the official `@highlightjs/cdn-assets` package, pinned at 11.12.0:
https://github.com/highlightjs/cdn-release

- `core.min.js`: `es/core.min.js`
- `python.min.js`: `es/languages/python.min.js`
- `github.min.css`: `styles/github.min.css`
- `LICENSE`: upstream BSD-3-Clause license

The reader registers only Python and serves all assets locally. See the upstream usage documentation: https://highlightjs.org/#usage .
